title: Special Notice for Case Processing Operations Center 2.0
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE COUNTERINTELLIGENCE AND SECURITY AGENCY (DCSA).DEFENSE CI AND SECURITY AGENCY
detail_text: Please be advised that the solicitation release for CPOC 2.0 is delayed.Consequently, all current reading room registrations will be cancelled, and no new registrations will be processed until the final solicitation has been published. The Government will reassess the acquisition timeline to ensure all prospective offerors are afforded adequate time for proposal submission. Interested parties should continue to monitor SAM.gov for further information/updates.
